contract_notes: The authoritative payment-required header used an x402 v2 envelope and CAIP-2 network eip155:8453, while the compatibility JSON body also exposed x402Version 1 and network base. This is recorded as a dual representation, not classified as a defect.
The Bazaar manifest example describes the inner tool body {lei: ...}; the live REST route itself required the outer {input: {...}} wrapper.
No challenge nonce field was observed in the captured payment-required header. No conclusion is drawn at Phase 1 because the payer-generated EIP-3009 authorization has not yet been constructed.
limitations: No paid request has yet been signed or sent.
No USDC settlement has yet been attempted or observed.
The free-tier LEI result has not yet been independently checked against a separately implemented ISO 7064 MOD-97-10 calculation.
The XDR-1 receipt signature has not yet been independently recovered or verified.
This Phase 1 record supports the observed payment contract and scope representation only; it is not a paid-fulfilment result or trust rating.
conclusion: Phase 1 independently established the live code402 LEI Check request shape, free-tier behaviour, published payment metadata and an authoritative HTTP 402 payment challenge. Paid fulfilment, deterministic output validation and XDR-1 receipt verification remain pending.
